disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of the qwen model experiencing HTTP 400 API errors when attempting to review .SRCINFO and modrinth-enhanced.sh, resulting in an overall inconclusive verdict. learnings: When aggregating multi-model audits, if one model fails to review specific files due to transient API errors, the system should check if another model in the ensemble successfully reviewed those exact files.
